title: Embedded firmware engineer
description: A 5-year C/C++/FreeRTOS/STM32 embedded firmware engineer evaluated against 8 postings: a strong connected-sensor firmware match with Zephyr/Yocto gaps, a good smart-metering firmware match, a marginal robotics software role, and five cross-domain distractors including pure web positions.
rationale: A cross-domain separation scenario: an embedded C/C++ resume is scored against firmware roles, an adjacent robotics role, and pure web/analytics/marketing/DevOps distractors. Gap target j1 (connected-sensor firmware) overlaps fully on C, C++, Cortex-M, I2C/SPI drivers, FreeRTOS, and battery-powered device work, while requiring Zephyr RTOS and Embedded Linux (Yocto) that the resume clearly lacks; secure OTA update workflows are only partially covered by the resume's encrypted UART bootloader (medium), and Rust is a preferred-only gap (low). j2 (smart water-meter firmware) is the same family and worth applying, but the role's ultrasonic-metrology and cellular-modem core is absent from the resume, so grade 2 rather than 3. j3 (robotics software) is the deliberate marginal case: genuine modern-C++ overlap, but the job family is Linux-based autonomy application software rather than microcontroller firmware, so grade 1. The React frontend and Node full-stack postings are pure web roles sharing essentially no tokens or competencies with the resume, and together with the data-analyst, marketing, and DevOps distractors they pin the grade-0 floor.

resume.summary: Embedded firmware engineer with 5 years of experience shipping C/C++ firmware for STM32 Cortex-M devices under FreeRTOS. Deep in sensor driver development over I2C, SPI, and UART, with a focus on low-power, battery-operated BLE products.

jobs.raw_text:
Firmware Engineer, Connected Sensors — Brightmesh Systems (Hybrid, Boulder CO)

Brightmesh builds wireless sensor networks that monitor air quality and energy use in commercial buildings. We are hiring a Firmware Engineer to own device firmware across our sensor line.

What you will do:
- Develop and maintain C/C++ firmware for our Cortex-M sensor nodes on Zephyr RTOS
- Port legacy FreeRTOS-based STM32 products onto the Zephyr platform
- Implement and debug sensor drivers over I2C and SPI
- Extend the Embedded Linux (Yocto) gateway that aggregates sensor traffic

Requirements: C, C++, Zephyr RTOS, Embedded Linux (Yocto), secure OTA firmware update workflows. 4+ years of embedded firmware development and experience shipping battery-powered wireless devices. BSEE/BSCS or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have: Rust, LoRaWAN, MISRA C.

Embedded Firmware Engineer — Aquaflow Metering (Onsite, Tulsa OK)

Aquaflow builds smart water meters deployed across municipal utilities. We are hiring an Embedded Firmware Engineer for our next-generation residential meter.

You will write C firmware for ultra-low-power ARM Cortex-M0+ microcontrollers under FreeRTOS, implement I2C/SPI drivers for flow and temperature sensors, tune sleep currents against a 10-year battery-life target, and integrate an NB-IoT modem for daily usage reporting.

Requirements: C, FreeRTOS, ARM Cortex-M, I2C/SPI peripheral drivers, low-power firmware design. 4+ years of embedded development on battery-powered devices.

Bonus: NB-IoT or LTE-M modem integration, ultrasonic metrology signal processing.

Robotics Software Engineer — Kinetic Harvest (Onsite, Fresno CA)

Kinetic Harvest builds autonomous orchard tractors. We need a Robotics Software Engineer for our navigation team.

You will develop C++ nodes in ROS 2 for perception and motion planning, integrate lidar and camera pipelines, tune path-tracking controllers on Ubuntu-based onboard computers, and run field tests with the hardware team during harvest season.

Requirements: modern C++ (C++17), ROS 2, Linux application development, motion planning or controls. 3+ years building robotics or autonomy software.

Bonus: CUDA, sensor fusion (EKF).

Bonus: ProseMirror or Slate, realtime collaboration over WebSockets.

Data Analyst — Marlowe Retail Group (Hybrid, Columbus OH)

Marlowe Retail Group operates 140 home-goods stores across the Midwest. We are hiring a Data Analyst to support merchandising decisions.

You will build weekly sales and inventory dashboards in Tableau, write SQL against our Snowflake warehouse, analyze promotion performance by category, and present findings to category managers and finance partners.

Requirements: SQL, Tableau, Excel, stakeholder communication. 2+ years in an analytics role.

Bonus: Python (pandas), dbt.

Requirements: Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, CI/CD tooling, Linux administration. 4+ years in DevOps or platform engineering roles.

Bonus: Go, cloud cost optimization at scale.
